## Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
theme_set(theme_bw(18))

# Load the soil core data
soil_cores <- read_csv("recorded_lectures/exide-soil-cores.csv") |> 
    filter(pb_ppm <= 5e3) |> 
    left_join(
        read_csv("recorded_lectures/exide-property-covariates.csv"), 
        by = "property_id"
    ) |> 
        mutate(home_age = 2026 - year_built) |> 
        drop_na(pb_ppm, home_age, location_code)
```

# Visualize the data

Plot home age on the x-axis, soil lead on the y axis, and location (DL ir YD) in color.

```{r}
ggplot(soil_cores, aes(home_age, pb_ppm, color = location_code)) +
    geom_point(shape = 21, alpha = 0.5) +
    labs(x = "Home Age (years)", y = "Soil lead (ppm)", color = "Location")
```

# Fit the model and interpret

The differnece in the `lm()` model formula between additive and interactive models is `*` versus a `+`.

```{r}
age_location_lm <- lm(pb_ppm ~ home_age * location_code, soil_cores)
summary(age_location_lm)
```
